build_named_indexer_for_mjdata: build a named indexer for a MuJoCo mjdata struct to access fields like xpos by body name
build_named_indexer_for_mjmodel: build a named indexer for a MuJoCo mjmodel struct to access fields like body_pos by body name
create_axis_indexers_from_model: create axis indexers from a MuJoCo model mapping size names to RegularNamedAxis or RaggedNamedAxis instances
create_field_indexer_for_struct_field: create a FieldIndexer for a specific struct field to enable named string-based indexing on numpy arrays
create_struct_indexer_container: create an immutable StructIndexer container exposing FieldIndexer attributes for all dynamic array fields in a MuJoCo struct
